# Sieve API contract

<!-- generated by tools/protocolgen — edit the declarations, not this file -->

This file is generated from `sieve/protocol` and the assembled router.
Every description below is a godoc comment or a `doc:"…"` struct tag read out of
the source, so the way to change this document is to change the declaration it
describes and run `go generate ./sieve/protocol`.

Package protocol is the single source of truth for Sieve's wire contract: the frames of the two WebSocket channels (document and workspace) and the typed bodies of the JSON endpoints.

## WebSocket channels

Channel names a WebSocket wire.

Subprotocol: `sieve.v1`.

WSSubprotocol is the subprotocol a dial on either wire negotiates, and the
server selects it on every accepted upgrade.

It is half of a credential, not decoration. Both wires ride the loopback
listener — WebKitGTK cannot carry an upgrade over the app's custom scheme —
and any local process can reach that listener, so an upgrade must prove it
comes from the shell this run served. The browser WebSocket API cannot set a
request header, so the proof rides the one list it can send: a client offers
this word FIRST and the run's token SECOND. The server answers with this word
alone, so the token appears in no response header.

### `workspace` — `/api/ws/workspace`

**Client → server**

| Type | Payload | Correlated on | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | `protocol.CommandFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandFrame dispatches one slash command. |
| `command-cancel` | `protocol.CommandCancelFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandCancelFrame cancels an in-flight command by its correlation id. |
| `feature-control` | `protocol.FeatureControlFrame` | — | FeatureControlFrame switches one text-service feature on or off, and says what it is to work with. |
| `ink-page-drawn` | `protocol.InkPageDrawnFrame` | `correlationId` | InkPageDrawnFrame answers an ink-draw-page with the page as a PNG, or why it could not be drawn. |
| `mention-query` | `protocol.MentionQueryFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionQueryFrame is the `@`-picker's typeahead question. |
| `mention-resolve` | `protocol.MentionResolveFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResolveFrame asks where a coordinate opens. |
| `ping` | `protocol.PingFrame` | — | PingFrame is a liveness probe, answered with a PongFrame. |
| `session-scroll` | `protocol.SessionScrollFrame` | — | SessionScrollFrame persists one tab's scroll offset, debounced up while the user scrolls and pulled again at tab deactivation. |
| `spell-ignore` | `protocol.SpellIgnoreFrame` | — | SpellIgnoreFrame stops a word being flagged for the rest of this run. |
| `spell-learn` | `protocol.SpellLearnFrame` | — | SpellLearnFrame adds a word to the user's durable dictionary, which survives a restart. |

**Server → client**

| Type | Payload | Correlated on | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command-result` | `protocol.CommandResultFrame` | `correlationId` | CommandResultFrame reports one step of a command's lifecycle. |
| `container-deleted` | `protocol.ContainerDeletedFrame` | — | ContainerDeletedFrame is NEWS, not an instruction: the container it names is already gone from the store, and every workspace socket hears so. |
| `container-saved` | `protocol.ContainerSavedFrame` | — | ContainerSavedFrame is NEWS: the container it names has just reached disk, and every workspace socket hears so. |
| `ink-draw-page` | `protocol.InkDrawPageFrame` | `correlationId` | InkDrawPageFrame asks one workspace client to draw a page of a Digital Note as a PNG, and is answered by an ink-page-drawn carrying the same correlation id. |
| `invalidate` | `protocol.InvalidateFrame` | — | InvalidateFrame tells every connected workspace socket that a subject changed and the views showing it are stale. |
| `jobs-changed` | `protocol.JobsChangedFrame` | — | JobsChangedFrame broadcasts the whole job snapshot whenever it changes. |
| `mention-resolved` | `protocol.MentionResolvedFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResolvedFrame answers "where does this coordinate open" with something the client can ACT on — a document to open, a block to reveal — and never anything it would have to parse. |
| `mention-result` | `protocol.MentionResultFrame` | `correlationId` | MentionResultFrame answers a typeahead. |
| `pong` | `protocol.PongFrame` | — | PongFrame answers a PingFrame. |

## Invalidation topics

Topic is what an invalidate frame invalidates — the subject a view refetches when it hears one.

| Topic | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `notes` | the note/folder tree changed |
| `session` | tabs, active tab, or panel state changed |
| `prompts` | the prompt library changed |
| `library` | the open library changed |
| `intent` | a document's user_intent changed |
| `ink` | the ink link, its last session's numbers or the synced notes changed |

## Frame reference

### `document` channel

#### `block-op` — client → server

BlockOpFrame applies one granular operation to the authoritative block tree.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the block-op-ack; absent means no ack is sent |
| `op` | `block.BlockOp` | yes |  |

#### `detect-extractions` — client → server

DetectExtractionsFrame asks which blocks a selection could become — the offer list behind the extract menu.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the detect-extractions-result reply |
| `sourceKind` | `string` | yes | the kind the selection came from; shapes which offers make sense |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | yes | the selection, one entry per clipboard-style view |

#### `doc-update` — client → server

DocUpdateFrame carries the markdown-mode buffer's current text to the shadow document.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `markdown` | `string` | yes | the whole buffer, not a diff |

#### `enter-markdown` — client → server

EnterMarkdownFrame switches the document to markdown mode: the server embeds the current block state into markdown and answers with a MarkdownContentFrame carrying the merged text to seed the markdown editor.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the markdown-content reply |

#### `enter-wysiwyg` — client → server

EnterWysiwygFrame switches the document to WYSIWYG mode, re-parsing the block tree from the markdown the client holds and answering with a WysiwygContentFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `markdown` | `*string` | no | the buffer to re-parse; absent means keep what the shadow holds |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the wysiwyg-content reply |

#### `export` — client → server

ExportFrame asks for clean whole-document text in an export format — the clipboard exports, with AI blocks excluded because prior Q&A is conversation, not document content.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the export-content reply |
| `format` | `string` | no | markdown (the default), confluence (Confluence Server/Data Center storage format) or confluence-cloud (Confluence Cloud storage format) |

#### `extract` — client → server

ExtractFrame creates a block from selected content — the additive extract/paste mechanic and the in-place transform, told apart by Operation.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the extract-ack |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes | the source block: transformed in place, or extracted from — and the anchor the extracted block lands after |
| `targetKind` | `string` | yes | the block kind to create |
| `operation` | `block.Action` | no | empty means extract — the additive default |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | yes | the selection, one entry per clipboard-style view |

#### `feature-control` — client → server

FeatureControlFrame switches one text-service feature on or off, and says what it is to work with.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `feature` | `string` | yes | which producer this is about; a word from the registered feature vocabulary, refused when nothing serves it |
| `enabled` | `bool` | yes | the state the feature is being put INTO, not a request to flip |
| `parameters` | `map[string]interface {}` | no | what the feature is to work with; interpreted by that feature alone |

#### `flush` — client → server

FlushFrame asks the shadow document to persist now rather than on its debounce.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `focus` — client → server

FocusFrame is the dwell ping: the user is looking at this document, which raises its focus count.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `ink-describe` — client → server

InkDescribeFrame asks for this channel's Digital Note to be named now: its name, summary, keywords and categories described again from its pages, whether or not they are of the note as it stands.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |

InkTranscriptFrame asks what is known of the transcript of one page of this channel's Digital Note.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |

#### `ink-transcript-document` — client → server

InkTranscriptDocumentFrame asks for a new document made from the transcript of one page of this channel's Digital Note: an ordinary untitled note holding a copy of the transcript's blocks, linked to nothing.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the ink-transcript-document-result reply |

#### `load` — client → server

LoadFrame asks for the document this channel is bound to, as the editor mounts it.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the load-content reply |

#### `paste` — client → server

PasteFrame hands a clipboard to the server to make sense of.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | no | echoed on the paste-ack |
| `kind` | `protocol.PasteKind` | yes | smart \| place \| slice \| native-drop \| native-clipboard. SECURITY: native-drop and native-clipboard make the server read files the NATIVE side caught (the drop bucket) or the OS clipboard names — never paths from the wire, so the wire carries the GESTURE, not a filesystem address. The socket upgrade gates keep these to the app's own page: an origin allow-list refuses a foreign browser page, and a per-run token refuses every other local process. |
| `entries` | `[]block.ContentEntry` | no | smart: the clipboard's views. place: the views the host is placing. native-drop: absent — the server takes the paths from the native drop bucket the OS-level catch fed (Wails OnFileDrop); the page's own view of a drop is never consulted. native-clipboard: absent — the server reads the clipboard itself |
| `slice` | `[][]block.ContentEntry` | no | slice only: one view set per copied block, in order |
| `afterBlockId` | `string` | no | insert after this block; an id the document does not hold appends |
| `atFront` | `bool` | no | insert at position 0; ignored when afterBlockId is set |

#### `ping` — client → server

PingFrame is a liveness probe, answered with a PongFrame.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |

#### `retry-block-job` — client → server

RetryBlockJobFrame re-runs the job of one block that failed or was interrupted.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `id` | `string` | yes | the block whose job re-runs |

#### `set-presenting` — client → server

SetPresentingFrame records whether the document is in Presentation Mode on the session's tab, so a reopened tab is handed it back on the load answer.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `presenting` | `bool` | yes | true while the document is presented |

#### `text-replace` — client → server

TextReplaceFrame asks for one anchored run of a block's text to be replaced.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `opId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes | the block whose text is being written |
| `locator` | `string` | yes | exactly what the mark carried, unread; an arbitrary per-kind payload only the block's processor interprets |
| `quote` | `string` | yes | the exact text to replace; the anchor, not a label |
| `occurrence` | `int` | yes | 0-based index among identical quotes in the same segment |
| `grain` | `string` | yes | how the occurrence is counted — word: among identical word runs; literal: among non-overlapping left-to-right literal matches. Carried from the anchor unread; a request naming neither word is refused rather than guessed at |
| `start` | `int` | yes | byte offset hint into the segment's reading as the client last saw it |
| `end` | `int` | yes | byte offset hint, exclusive |
| `replacement` | `string` | yes | what to put in the quote's place; an empty string deletes the run |

#### `ink-log-restarted` — server → client

InkLogRestartedFrame is the note's log started again from its first record in this channel's container.

### `workspace` channel

#### `command` — client → server

CommandFrame dispatches one slash command.

| `cmd` | `string` | yes | the verb, without its slash |
| `args` | `protocol.CommandArgs` | yes |  |
| `correlationId` | `string` | yes | required — a command with no correlation id is dropped, because its result could not be routed |
| `context` | `json.RawMessage` | no | whatever the invoking surface knows about the selection, shaped by that surface |
| `attachments` | `[]domain.Attachment` | no | coordinates the composer attached with @; what a command does with them is its own business |
| `body` | `[]protocol.CommandBlock` | no | the message after the verb as ordered blocks; the structured projection of args.text — a command consumes whichever fits |

## Typed HTTP endpoints

An endpoint appears here when its contract is typed data in either direction.
Everything else the app serves is hypermedia or bytes, and appears in the route
inventory below instead.

| Operation | Response | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/document/load` | json | DocumentLoadRequest reads a channel-less pseudo-document's content. |
| `POST /api/document/save` | json | DocumentSaveRequest writes a document's buffer to disk. |
| `DELETE /api/document/{uuid}/asset/{key}` | none | AssetDeleteRequest deletes one asset of a document, irreversibly: {uuid} is the document and {key} the asset's key, path-escaped. |
| `POST /api/folder` | fragment | FolderCreateRequest makes a new folder. |
| `PATCH /api/folder/{id}` | fragment | FolderPatchRequest changes a folder's properties. |
| `GET /api/ink/live/note` | json | InkLiveNoteRequest asks which synced Digital Note the Live view mirrors. |
| `POST /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/describe` | none | InkDescribeRequest names a synced Digital Note now: {uuid} is the note's block container, and its name, summary, keywords and categories are described again from its pages, whether or not they are of the note as it stands. |
| `POST /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/open-on-tablet` | json | InkOpenOnTabletRequest asks the tablet a synced Digital Note came from to open it, leaving the page to the tablet: {uuid} is the note's block container. |
| `GET /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/pages/{page}/export` | json | InkPageExportRequest reads one page of a synced Digital Note in the export shape of docs/ink-contract.md §4.2: {uuid} is the note's block container and {page} the page's index among the pages present, from 0. |
| `GET /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/pages/{page}/image` | image | InkPageImageRequest reads one page of a synced Digital Note as a PNG, drawn by the app's window when no image of the page as it stands is kept: {uuid} is the note's block container and {page} the page's index among the pages present, from 0. |
| `PATCH /api/note/{id}` | fragment | NotePatchRequest changes a note's properties. |
| `POST /api/tabs/close` | fragment | TabsCloseRequest closes every listed tab — the ONE close mechanism. |

### `GET /api/document/load`

**Request** — `protocol.DocumentLoadRequest`

DocumentLoadRequest reads a channel-less pseudo-document's content.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the prompt pseudo-document id (prompt:{name}); a query parameter, not a body field |

**Response** — `protocol.DocumentContent`

DocumentContent is a container as the editor mounts it: for a document the buffer, the mode it was last in, and — in WYSIWYG — the block list it renders from; for a block container its one block.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `body` | `string` | yes | raw markdown, frontmatter already stripped |
| `mode` | `string` | yes | wysiwyg \| markdown — the mode this document was last in |
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | empty when nothing was found, which the client treats as an empty document |
| `kind` | `string` | no | the container's own noun: note \| buffer \| prompt \| a block kind; absent when nothing was found |
| `name` | `string` | no | what the container is called; absent when it has no name |
| `scroll` | `int` | yes | the tab's saved scroll offset; 0 parks at the top |
| `version` | `int` | yes | the version of the content served here; 0 when the container keeps no version history |
| `presenting` | `bool` | no | the tab was last left in Presentation Mode; absent when it was not |
| `blocks` | `[]block.FrontendBlock` | no | WYSIWYG only: the block list, already through the shadow so ids are stable |

### `POST /api/document/save`

**Request** — `protocol.DocumentSaveRequest`

DocumentSaveRequest writes a document's buffer to disk.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uuid` | `string` | yes | the prompt pseudo-document id (prompt:{name}); a query parameter, not a body field |
| `body` | `string` | yes | the whole buffer |
| `mode` | `string` | no | records which mode saved it; empty leaves the recorded mode alone |

**Response** — `protocol.DocumentSaveResponse`

DocumentSaveResponse reports the version the save produced.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `int` | yes | the saved document's new version number; 0 for a container that keeps no version history |

### `DELETE /api/document/{uuid}/asset/{key}`

Path parameters: `uuid`, `key`

**Request** — `protocol.AssetDeleteRequest`

AssetDeleteRequest deletes one asset of a document, irreversibly: {uuid} is the document and {key} the asset's key, path-escaped.

**Response** — 204, or a body no caller reads.

### `POST /api/folder`

**Request** — `protocol.FolderCreateRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

FolderCreateRequest makes a new folder.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `PATCH /api/folder/{id}`

Path parameters: `id`

**Request** — `protocol.FolderPatchRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

FolderPatchRequest changes a folder's properties.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `*string` | no | the new display name; absent leaves it alone |
| `open` | `*bool` | no | whether the folder is expanded in the tree; absent leaves it alone |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `GET /api/ink/live/note`

**Request** — `protocol.InkLiveNoteRequest`

InkLiveNoteRequest asks which synced Digital Note the Live view mirrors.

**Response** — `protocol.InkLiveNoteResponse`

InkLiveNoteResponse names the note the Live view mirrors.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `note` | `string` | yes | the uuid of the block container holding the mirrored note; empty when there is no Live view or no container holds its note yet |

### `POST /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/describe`

Path parameters: `uuid`

**Request** — `protocol.InkDescribeRequest`

InkDescribeRequest names a synced Digital Note now: {uuid} is the note's block container, and its name, summary, keywords and categories are described again from its pages, whether or not they are of the note as it stands.

**Response** — 204, or a body no caller reads.

### `POST /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/open-on-tablet`

Path parameters: `uuid`

**Request** — `protocol.InkOpenOnTabletRequest`

InkOpenOnTabletRequest asks the tablet a synced Digital Note came from to open it, leaving the page to the tablet: {uuid} is the note's block container.

**Response** — `protocol.InkOpenOnTabletResponse`

InkOpenOnTabletResponse is what came of an InkOpenOnTabletRequest.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | `string` | yes | opened \| no-tablet \| other-tablet \| refused \| no-answer, as ink-open-on-tablet-result names them |
| `reason` | `string` | no | refused only: the tablet's reason, not-foreground \| not-offered \| another |
| `message` | `string` | yes | what came of it, in words a person can be shown |

### `GET /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/pages/{page}/export`

Path parameters: `uuid`, `page`

**Request** — `protocol.InkPageExportRequest`

InkPageExportRequest reads one page of a synced Digital Note in the export shape of docs/ink-contract.md §4.2: {uuid} is the note's block container and {page} the page's index among the pages present, from 0.

**Response** — `protocol.InkPageExport`

InkPageExport is one page of a Digital Note as the ink renderer takes it: the note's header and the page's strokes in the order they were added.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `note` | `protocol.InkExportNote` | yes |  |
| `strokes` | `[]protocol.InkExportStroke` | yes |  |

### `GET /api/ink/notes/{uuid}/pages/{page}/image`

Path parameters: `uuid`, `page`

**Request** — `protocol.InkPageImageRequest`

InkPageImageRequest reads one page of a synced Digital Note as a PNG, drawn by the app's window when no image of the page as it stands is kept: {uuid} is the note's block container and {page} the page's index among the pages present, from 0.

**Response** — a PNG, image/png.

### `PATCH /api/note/{id}`

Path parameters: `id`

**Request** — `protocol.NotePatchRequest`

Accepts `application/json` or `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, under the same field names.

NotePatchRequest changes a note's properties.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | the new display name |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

### `POST /api/tabs/close`

**Request** — `protocol.TabsCloseRequest`

TabsCloseRequest closes every listed tab — the ONE close mechanism.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | `[]string` | yes | the tabs to close |

**Response** — HTML for HTMX to swap in; the template is its contract.

## Payload types

Types a frame or an endpoint carries inside its envelope. Each is described on
its own declaration, in the package that owns it.

### `block.Action`

Action is an operation a processor can perform on a set of ContentEntry views.

### `block.Anchor`

Anchor names where a created block lands: by the id of the block it follows, never by a position.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `afterBlockId` | `string` | no | insert after this block; an id the document does not hold appends |
| `atFront` | `bool` | no | insert at position 0; ignored when afterBlockId is set |

### `block.BlockOp`

BlockOp is a granular mutation of the BlockDoc tree, carried over the wire (Stage C, spec §4).

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | yes |  |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | no |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |
| `aliases` | `[]string` | no |  |
| `index` | `int` | yes |  |
| `afterBlockId` | `string` | no | insert after this block; an id the document does not hold appends |
| `atFront` | `bool` | no | insert at position 0; ignored when afterBlockId is set |
| `parentId` | `string` | no |  |
| `order` | `[]string` | no | set-order only: the complete top-level block id order to install |

### `block.ContentEntry`

ContentEntry is one item from the browser clipboard DataTransfer.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mimeType` | `string` | yes |  |
| `content` | `string` | yes |  |
| `context` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |

### `block.FrontendBlock`

FrontendBlock is the wire shape the WYSIWYG editor renders from (Stage D.2).

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | no |  |
| `aliases` | `[]string` | no |  |

### `block.PasteOutcome`

PasteOutcome discriminates what a paste round-trip actually did.

### `block.PasteResult`

PasteResult is what one paste did — a discriminated union, not a bag of optional flags.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | `block.PasteOutcome` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | no |  |
| `id` | `string` | no |  |
| `rawYaml` | `string` | no |  |
| `html` | `string` | no |  |

### `block.SupportedActions`

SupportedActions is one processor's offer for a set of entries: its Kind plus the operations it supports.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `actions` | `[]block.Action` | yes |  |

### `domain.Attachment`

Attachment is a live edge to another NodeDescriptor in the system: the address of something Sieve already holds, offered as context for one AI turn.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uri` | `string` | yes |  |
| `title` | `string` | no |  |

### `domain.Candidate`

Candidate is one hit of a search, and the one hit type every consumer reads: what the picker, the sidebar, the quick switcher and MCP show, and what an accepted mention persists.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `uri` | `string` | yes |  |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `detail` | `string` | yes |  |
| `summary` | `string` | yes |  |
| `folder` | `string` | no |  |
| `tags` | `[]string` | no |  |
| `modified` | `string` | no |  |
| `matched` | `domain.SearchFields` | no |  |

### `domain.JobInfo`

JobInfo describes one background job the UI can see: what the tab spinner and the jobs view render, and what the workspace wire's jobs-changed frame carries.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jobId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `label` | `string` | yes |  |
| `docId` | `string` | no |  |
| `spinTab` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `state` | `string` | no |  |
| `category` | `string` | no |  |

### `domain.SearchField`

SearchField is one face of a thing that a search's terms are matched against.

### `domain.SearchFields`

SearchFields is a set of SearchField.

### `protocol.CommandArgs`

CommandArgs is the message after the verb, as the caller's raw text/plain.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | yes | the message after the verb as raw text; the string projection of what body carries as blocks |

### `protocol.CommandBlock`

CommandBlock is a block as the command wire carries it, in either direction: the kind, and everything that kind owns.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | yes |  |
| `attrs` | `map[string]interface {}` | yes |  |

### `protocol.InkExportDevice`

InkExportDevice is the tablet the note was written on.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `model` | `string` | yes |  |

### `protocol.InkExportNote`

InkExportNote is the header of the note a page belongs to.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes | the companion's note id |
| `created` | `string` | yes | RFC 3339 in UTC |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `pageAspect` | `float32` | yes | page width over page height |
| `template` | `*protocol.InkExportTemplate` | no | the note's default page template; null when it has none |
| `device` | `protocol.InkExportDevice` | yes |  |

### `protocol.InkExportPoint`

InkExportPoint is one sampled pen point, in page units.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | `float32` | yes |  |
| `y` | `float32` | yes |  |
| `pressure` | `float32` | yes | 0 to 1 |
| `tMillis` | `uint32` | yes | milliseconds from the stroke's first point |
| `tiltX` | `int8` | yes |  |
| `tiltY` | `int8` | yes |  |
| `size` | `float32` | yes | always 0 in an export |

### `protocol.InkExportStroke`

InkExportStroke is one stroke on the page.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `tool` | `string` | yes |  |
| `widthClass` | `uint8` | yes |  |
| `startMillis` | `uint64` | yes | milliseconds since the note's created |
| `points` | `[]protocol.InkExportPoint` | yes |  |

### `protocol.InkExportTemplate`

InkExportTemplate is a page template: its id and its parameters by name.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `params` | `map[string]float64` | yes |  |

### `protocol.InkLiveRecord`

InkLiveRecord is one record about the stroke under the pen on the live page, or about the window a whiteboard is viewed through, in page units.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `record` | `string` | yes | begin \| point \| end \| remove \| view |
| `stroke` | `uint32` | yes | numbers the stroke within one connection to the tablet, not its id; 0 on a view |
| `tool` | `string` | no | begin only: pen \| pencil |
| `widthClass` | `uint8` | no | begin only: 1, 2 or 3 |
| `x` | `float64` | yes | page units: a begin's origin, a point's place, a view's left edge; 0 otherwise |
| `y` | `float64` | yes | page units: a begin's origin, a point's place, a view's top edge; 0 otherwise |
| `pressure` | `float64` | yes | point only: 0 to 1 |
| `tMillis` | `uint32` | yes | point only: milliseconds since its stroke's begin |
| `tiltX` | `int8` | yes | point only: degrees |
| `tiltY` | `int8` | yes | point only: degrees |

### `protocol.InkTranscript`

InkTranscript is what is known of the transcript of one page.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `string` | yes | none \| ready (a transcript of the page as it is now) \| stale (a transcript of the page as it was before it changed) |
| `key` | `string` | no | the page key the transcript is of; absent with none |
| `blocks` | `[]block.FrontendBlock` | no | the transcript, in the page's order, in the shape a load's blocks take; absent with none |
| `running` | `bool` | yes | a transcript of the page is under way |
| `available` | `bool` | yes | false while nothing can transcribe a page |
| `unavailable` | `string` | no | why nothing can transcribe a page; present only when available is false |
| `failed` | `string` | no | what went wrong the last time the page was transcribed; absent when nothing did |

### `protocol.JobsSnapshot`

JobsSnapshot is every job the UI can see, in insertion order.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `[]domain.JobInfo` | yes | jobs a worker is running now; never null |
| `queued` | `[]domain.JobInfo` | yes | jobs waiting for a worker; never null |

### `protocol.PasteKind`

PasteKind discriminates what a paste is asking for.

### `protocol.TextMarkWire`

TextMarkWire is one marked run of text inside a block, as it travels on the wire.

| Field | Go type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `locator` | `string` | yes | everything the block's processor needs to place a write back into the text this was read from; an arbitrary per-kind payload, opaque everywhere else — carry it back unread |
| `quote` | `string` | yes | the exact text marked; the anchor, not a label |
| `occurrence` | `int` | yes | 0-based index among identical quotes in the same segment |
| `grain` | `string` | yes | how the occurrence is counted — word: among identical word runs; literal: among non-overlapping left-to-right literal matches. Declared, never inferred, and a mark carrying neither word resolves nowhere |
| `start` | `int` | yes | byte offset hint into the segment's reading as the server made it |
| `end` | `int` | yes | byte offset hint, exclusive |
| `class` | `string` | yes | the kind of language the segment holds — prose, code, label, caption, key |
| `suggestions` | `[]string` | yes | never null — replacements offered for the quote, best first |

### `protocol.Topic`

Topic is what an invalidate frame invalidates — the subject a view refetches when it hears one.

## Command words

Every registered verb. They ride the workspace wire's `command` frame as DATA —
a new command is not a new frame type — and are listed because a client has to
spell both the verb and the family it is invoked within: the dispatcher rejects
a verb sent under a family that is not its own.

| Family | Command | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `ai` | `/btw` | Quick answer in a popup — nothing is added to the document |
| `ai` | `/file` | File this document where the AI's evaluation says it belongs |
| `ai` | `/keep-and-file` | Mark this document as kept, then file it |
| `ai` | `/metadata` | Re-evaluate this document's title, summary and tags |
| `ai` | `/summary` | 3-bullet summary of document or selection |
| `ai` | `/todo` | Extract open action items, TODOs, and decisions as a checklist |
| `util` | `/base64` | Base64 encode/decode inline text, selection, or document |
| `util` | `/env` | Go runtime info: OS, arch, CPUs, goroutines, memory |
| `util` | `/hash` | SHA-256 hash of inline text, selection, or document |
| `util` | `/jwt` | Decode & inspect a JWT header + payload (no signature verification) |
| `util` | `/migrate-ids` | Upgrade every document's block ids to UUIDs so blocks are addressable |
| `util` | `/now` | Display current timestamp & date in all standard formats |
| `util` | `/stats` | Word count, character count, reading time & document metrics |
| `util` | `/uuid` | Generate a new random UUID v4 |

## Route inventory

Every route the app mounts, walked off the assembled router. `/ui/*` is safe,
idempotent views and bytes; `/api/*` is operations and protocols. A route whose
contract is typed data is described above; the rest serve hypermedia, bytes,
or another protocol's own transport.
